title: bellDelawareBench operation
description: The Bell-Delaware shell-side rating run at DECLARED fluid properties and geometry, printing every step of the textbook method (S_m, V_max, Re, ideal coefficient, Fc, Jc, the leakage and bypass areas, Fbp, the corrected coefficient, and with RL/RB the cross-flow and window pressure drops). Reproduces Hewitt, Shires & Bott Example 6.2 digit by digit. JL, JB, RL, RB are Bell's chart readings and are declared.

geometry.title: Bundle geometry
geometry.description: shellID, tubeOD, tubePitch, tubePattern (square | triangular | rotatedSquare), baffleSpacing, nTubes, tubeLength.

bellDelaware.title: Bell-Delaware inputs
bellDelaware.description: As the unit's bellDelaware block, plus the bench-only SmPrinted (the textbook's printed S_m).

shellFluid.title: Shell-side fluid
shellFluid.description: mdot, rho, mu, lambda, cp at the declared state.
